# String Methods

These methods belong to the default `core` group and are called on `string` receivers. All positions and lengths count Unicode code points.

| Entry | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`toUpperCase`](#touppercase) | `string.toUpperCase() => string` | Each code point replaced by its upper-case mapping in the case table. |
| [`toLowerCase`](#tolowercase) | `string.toLowerCase() => string` | Each code point replaced by its lower-case mapping in the case table. |
| [`trim`](#trim) | `string.trim() => string` | s without the white space at both ends. |
| [`removePrefix`](#removeprefix) | `string.removePrefix(prefix: string) => string` | s without prefix if s starts with it, else s. |
| [`removeSuffix`](#removesuffix) | `string.removeSuffix(suffix: string) => string` | s without suffix if s ends with it, else s. |
| [`startsWith`](#startswith) | `string.startsWith(prefix: string) => bool` | Whether the first code points of s are those of prefix. |
| [`endsWith`](#endswith) | `string.endsWith(suffix: string) => bool` | Whether the last code points of s are those of suffix. |
| [`split`](#split) | `string.split(sep: string) => string[]` | The parts of s between occurrences of sep. |
| [`replaceAll`](#replaceall) | `string.replaceAll(old: string, new: string) => string !` | s with each occurrence of old replaced by new, as literal text. |
| [`slice`](#slice) | `string.slice(start: int, end?: int) => string` | The code points of s from start up to but not including end. |
| [`repeat`](#repeat) | `string.repeat(count: int) => string !` | s repeated count times. |
| [`padStart`](#padstart) | `string.padStart(length: int, fill?: string) => string` | s with fill repeated before it up to length code points. |
| [`padEnd`](#padend) | `string.padEnd(length: int, fill?: string) => string` | s with fill repeated after it up to length code points. |
| [`indexOf`](#indexof) | `string.indexOf(search: string) => int \| null` | The position, in code points, of the first occurrence of search in s, or null. |

## `toUpperCase`

Each code point replaced by its upper-case mapping in the case table.

```text
string.toUpperCase: () => string
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Receiver | `string` |
| Parameters | None |
| Returns | `string` |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(s)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Examples**

| Expression | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `"café".toUpperCase()` | `"CAFÉ"` |
| `"ß".toUpperCase()` | `"ß"` |
| `"".toUpperCase()` | `""` |
| `"\u{3c2}".toUpperCase()` | `"Σ"` |
| `"\u{1c6}".toUpperCase()` | `"Ǆ"` |
| `"\u{fb01}".toUpperCase()` | `"ﬁ"` |

## `trim`

s without the white space at both ends.

```text

```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Receiver | `string` |
| Parameters | None |
| Returns | `string` |

## `split`

The parts of s between occurrences of sep.

```text
string.split: (sep: string) => string[]
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Receiver | `string` |
| Parameters | `sep: string` |
| Returns | `string[]` |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s) + p` |
| Allocation units | `1 + 2*p + sz(s)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"a,b,,c".split(",")` |  | `["a","b","","c"]` |
| `",".split(",")` |  | `["",""]` |
| `"aaa".split("aa")` |  | `["","a"]` |
| `"".split(",")` |  | `[""]` |
| `"a😀b".split("")` |  | `["a","😀","b"]` |
| `s.split(",")` | `s = "a,b,,c"` | `["a","b","","c"]` (5 steps, 9 units) |

## `replaceAll`

s with each occurrence of old replaced by new, as literal text.

```text
string.replaceAll: (old: string, new: string) => string !
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Receiver | `string` |
| Parameters | `old: string`; `new: string` |
| Returns | `string` (may fail with a value error, `!`) |
| Returns null | Never |
| Steps | `sz(s) + sz(result)` |
| Allocation units | `1 + sz(result)` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Run-time failures**

| Code | Kind | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-argument` (`empty-search`) | `value` | old is the empty string |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"a-b-c".replaceAll("-", "+")` |  | `"a+b+c"` |
| `"aaa".replaceAll("aa", "b")` |  | `"ba"` |
| `"x".replaceAll("y", "z")` |  | `"x"` |
| `"a.b".replaceAll(".", "$&")` |  | `"a$&b"` |
| `"😀x😀".replaceAll("😀", "")` |  | `"x"` |
| `s.replaceAll("-", "+")` | `s = "a-b-c"` | `"a+b+c"` (1 step, 1 unit) |
| `"abc".replaceAll("", "-")` |  | Fails: `invalid-argument` |

## `indexOf`

The position, in code points, of the first occurrence of search in s, or null.

```text
string.indexOf: (search: string) => int | null
```

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Receiver | `string` |
| Parameters | `search: string` |
| Returns | `int \| null` |
| Returns null | When search does not occur in s |
| Steps | `sz(s)` |
| Allocation units | `0` |
| Since | `3.0` |

**Examples**

| Expression | Inputs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"Order #1234 shipped".indexOf("#")` |  | `6` |
| `"a-b-c".indexOf("-")` |  | `1` |
| `"abc".indexOf("x")` |  | `null` |
